note: Generation task: no golden answers; properties.py alone carries every case (F3'', 2026-07-24: the LLM judge was removed — a small local judge waved through invented dates 3/3 and could not be trusted; see docs/sprint-map.md DECISION LOG). GATE runs deterministic (samples=1, temp 0). For a capability probe, temporarily set "samples": 3, "sample_temperature": 0.7 — gemma4 measured flaky there (signoff drops); verified 2026-07-18 that sampled runs are NOT reproducible enough to gate on locally.
not_verified: properties.py checks surface features (reply present, word limit, language match, signoff, no invented digits, no invented weekday/date) but not whether the reply is factually helpful, persuasive, on-topic, or professional in tone — those were the judge's job and are now UNCHECKED by design (de-judge, not de-quality: a generic 'thanks, I'll follow up' now passes). An invented claim stated in words rather than digits (e.g. a false capability claim) is not caught by check_no_invented_numbers or check_no_invented_dates.
